# std public actions (generated by actions.py; do not edit)

3241 of 6670 public action targets measured across 436 non-runtime modules.

Work actions: 2773 of 3158 measured, 385 excluded (they need a server, a socket, a terminal, a test context or a host resource; reasons in excluded.json). 3512 accessors, one-call wrappers and signatures without a body are covered through the benchmarks of their callers (#244, owner 2026-11-22); `--todo` lists the work actions still to measure.

Targets group overloads by name; a measured target does not imply all overloads are measured. Object constructors use `Object.new`; payload enum constructors use `Enum.case`. Role signatures are listed separately from implementations. Hidden declarations, caps, enum constants and runtime modules are excluded. Builtin targets stay in manifest.json.

Only explicitly declared measured calls count, not harness imports, fixture setup before timing or transitive implementation calls. Missing targets are a work list, not a correctness failure.
